desc:
This is a Cart Ride and a Tycoon mixed into one, buy tracks to explore the world. Buy better carts and walls to flex how rich u are! And try to reach heaven!

PINK TEPMPLE🛕
+3rd TIX TEMPLE (3M Tix)🎀
+Pink rocket cart (controllable CART!)🚀
+Trophy Room🏆
+Better UI, Price changes!

ARCADE UPDATE 2🎡
+ New arcade machine (Gold Miner!)🪙
+ 3 new wheel rewards!🎡
- Map changes.
- DATALOSS RESOLVED (If u lost ur data its back).

DAILY SPINS UPDATE🎡
3x new carts!
3x new gears!
Free Lava Wall Robux item!
One spin every day!

TIX TEMPLE 2 🎫 + Special Midas Hand gear!

+Lots of fixes/optimizations.

EVENTS UPDATE🔔

+3 new carts!😎
